fonts.$comment: Design 'Workday' (2026-11-25), whole site: Bricolage Grotesque for headlines, Inter for text. google_css is linked by the sign-up, quote page, portal, legal pages and the styleguide (the admin adds Noto Sans Hebrew); landing_css (same URL) by the generated marketing pages and their OG images.

landing_theme.$comment: Design 'Workday' (2026-11-25), the palette of the whole site under its marketing names: warm off-white page, near-black ink, one cobalt blue block color, warm yellow accent. site/assets/landing.css :root must use these exact values (tools/build_landing.py --check verifies); base.css holds the same colors (see 'theme'). AA contrast: ink on bg 17.2:1, muted on bg 5.7:1 and on white 6.2:1, white on blue 6.7:1 (small text on blue at least 86% white, 5.4:1), ink on sun 10.3:1, blue text on bg 6.2:1, sun on ink 10.3:1; sun on blue is 3.7:1, so yellow on blue only for large text (headline word, big prices).

theme.$comment: Site-wide palette, design 'Workday' (2026-11-25): warm off-white page, near-black ink, one cobalt blue accent, warm yellow for highlights. site/assets/base.css :root must use these exact values (tools/build_landing.py --check verifies); the key names are historic (design v2): ink/ink_2/ink_3 = near-black steps, paper = page background, screen = card white, violet = cobalt blue accent, violet_2 = soft blue tint, violet_deep = blue hover, amber = warm yellow, amber_2 = yellow hover. Same colors as landing_theme. AA contrast: ink on paper 17.2:1, muted #5D6170 on paper 5.7:1 and on white 6.2:1, blue text on paper 6.2:1, white on blue 6.7:1, ink on yellow 10.3:1, form field borders #8E8B80 3.2:1+ on paper and white.

social.$comment: Public profile URLs for the footer. Empty = not shown. Fill in only real profiles.

texting.$comment: Business texting (SMS) on the customer-facing site. enabled=false (launch default, until US carriers approve our A2P 10DLC registration): the client portal hides the 'Texting registration' setup step for FirstRing plan clients and does not count it. Turn it on together with the runtime's SMS_ENABLED switch (Railway env); the step then comes back by itself. Go-live never waits for this step (the server treats 'sms' as optional either way).

setup_agent.$comment: Setup assistant (AI chat in the portal's Setup tab, plan clients only; design 2026-11-27). enabled=false (default): the portal hides the chat and shows the forms, with no network call. The server has its own kill switch, private.settings.setup_agent_enabled (default false), plus a daily budget (setup_agent_daily_budget_usd, default 30) and per-user limits. The model is claude.setup_model; the API key is the Edge Function secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_SETUP (its own Console Workspace with a spend cap), falling back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

proof.worked_with: Worked with corporate clients in Israel, including a home-appliance importer.
proof.worked_with_status: owner decision 2026-11-25: description only, no client names until the client agrees

payments.$comment: Card / PayPal checkout on the quote page and in the portal (PayPal JS SDK buttons: guest card first, then PayPal; for an Israeli merchant no advanced card fields, Apple Pay or saved cards). PUBLIC values only: client_id is the public REST app client ID (it is in the SDK URL anyway). Secrets live only as Edge Function secrets PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID, PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET, PAYPAL_ENV, PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID (tools/us_setup.py --only paypal). enabled=false or an empty client_id = nothing PayPal is shown and Upwork Direct Contracts stays the default.

paddle.$comment: FirstRing monthly plans through Paddle Billing (merchant of record). PUBLIC values only, all PLACEHOLDERS until Meir fills them in from his Paddle account: client_token = Paddle > Developer tools > Authentication > client-side token (test_... in sandbox, live_... in production; Paddle.js only, never an API key). prices = 6 price IDs (pri_...): per plan one 'trial' price (monthly, 14-day trial, card required) for sign-up, and one 'paid' price (same monthly amount, NO trial) for 'Start paid plan' (trial already used) and for plan changes. Secrets are ONLY Edge Function secrets, typed by Meir in Supabase: PADDLE_API_KEY, PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, PADDLE_ENV (sandbox|production). enabled=false (default), an empty client_token or any empty price = the Paddle checkout is off and the mock / demo path stays (local, tests).
